smt-sep-set.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Set Theory
smt-sep-set.notes: ZF and ZFC axioms, the cumulative hierarchy, transfinite ordinals, cardinality, and independence context.

smt-openlogic-set.title: Open Logic Project, Set Theory
smt-openlogic-set.notes: Set construction, ordinals, cardinals, and choice. Companion reference to a collaboratively authored, openly licensed textbook.

smt-sep-choice.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, The Axiom of Choice
smt-sep-choice.notes: Equivalent forms of choice, well-ordering, Zorn lemma, and mathematical consequences.

smt-openlogic-slc.title: Richard Zach, Sets, Logic, Computation: An Open Introduction to Logic (Open Logic Project)
smt-openlogic-slc.notes: Metalogic, first-order semantics, soundness, completeness, compactness, Löwenheim-Skolem, and computability.

smt-openlogic-fol.title: Open Logic Project, First-Order Logic
smt-openlogic-fol.notes: Syntax, structures, formal derivations, the Henkin method, completeness, and compactness.

smt-sep-model.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Model Theory
smt-sep-model.notes: Structures, satisfaction, logical consequence, and the scope of first-order language.

smt-sep-godel.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems
smt-sep-godel.notes: Arithmetization, diagonal lemma, first and second incompleteness, Rosser refinement, nonstandard models, and undecidability distinctions.
